sections.title: Consultation bookings
sections.text: If you need to reschedule, contact us as early as possible. A booking may be moved subject to consultant availability and the terms confirmed at the time of payment.

sections.title: Work already performed
sections.text: Fees covering a completed consultation, assessment, document review or other work already delivered are generally not refundable.

sections.title: Services not yet started
sections.text: A written cancellation request for work that has not started will be reviewed against the signed service terms, payment method and any committed third-party costs.

sections.title: Government and third-party fees
sections.text: Government charges, biometrics, medical, translation, courier and other third-party fees are governed by the relevant provider and are not controlled by Mubeen Migration.

sections.title: How to request a review
sections.text: Email enquiries@mubeenmigration.com with your name, invoice or booking reference, payment date and reason for the request. We will review the service record and respond in writing.

items.question: Can Mubeen Migration guarantee visa approval?
items.answer: No. Decisions are made only by the relevant immigration authority. Our role is to improve route clarity, organisation and application readiness.

items.question: What should I bring to a consultation?
items.answer: Bring your passport, travel history, education or employment details, financial background and any previous refusal or immigration correspondence.

items.question: Can I book from outside Pakistan?
items.answer: Yes. We support clients internationally through online and telephone consultations.

items.question: Can you review a previous refusal?
items.answer: Yes. We can review the refusal reasons, submitted evidence and available next-step options. A review does not guarantee a different future outcome.

items.question: How long will my application take?
items.answer: Processing times vary by authority, category, location and case circumstances. Published estimates can change and are not guarantees.

items.question: Do you help choose the correct visa category?
items.answer: Yes. Route selection is a core part of the initial assessment because documents should only be prepared after the purpose and category are clear.
